source.label: Annual Report and Form 20-F Information 2024 (Exhibit 15.1 to FY2024 Form 20-F), Note 6 Segment information, Geographic areas (printed p. 167)

notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2024; AstraZeneca reports in US dollars. Documents read on sec.gov: FY2024 Form 20-F (accession 0001104659-25-014750) and its Exhibit 15.1, the 'Annual Report and Form 20-F Information 2024', which the 20-F incorporates by reference for Items 6.E and 7.A. OWNERSHIP: Pascal Soriot's beneficial interest at December 31, 2024 was 269,861 Ordinary Shares (including shares in holding and deferral periods not subject to performance or continued employment, on a gross basis). The report states no Director owns 1% or more, and the 20-F gives all Directors and SET members together 0.038% of the class at January 31, 2025, so pctEconomic is null (below 1%, not stated individually). He also had 308,139 shares subject to performance conditions under share plans, not included. MAJOR HOLDERS are percentages of issued share capital as notified under the UK FCA's DTR 5 rules. They are not updated unless a holder crosses a notifiable threshold, so the BlackRock (latest disclosure December 4, 2009) and Wellington (July 21, 2020) figures are the company's restatement of old notifications against the current share capital; asOf is each holder's latest disclosure date. CAPITAL GROUP: the annual report table shows 4.11% (disclosure of July 17, 2018) and says no changes were disclosed between December 31, 2024 and January 31, 2025, but Item 7.A of the 20-F reports a later DTR 5 notification of 4.997% on January 29, 2025; the 20-F figure is used. Investor AB (3.33%) is the next holder. Wellington Management Company LLP's 4.20% is included within Wellington Management Group LLP's and is not listed separately. DIVIDENDS: $4,602 million is dividends to the company's shareholders (Note 25). The cash-flow 'Dividends paid' line ($4,629 million) also includes $4 million to non-controlling interests, $16 million of dividend hedge contracts, $3 million exchange losses and $4 million of unclaimed-dividend movement (Note 25 reconciliation), so it is not used. BUYBACKS: none; AstraZeneca says no share repurchases have been made since 2012. The $81 million 'Own shares purchased by Employee Benefit Trusts' in the cash-flow statement is excluded under the employee-trust rule. GEOGRAPHY: Total Revenue by location of the selling legal entity, as reported. The note also shows the US at $21,806 million within The Americas. A separate table of Product Sales by customer location exists (Product Sales only, $50,938 million) and is not used.
